in_marathi.name: Kesavan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wisdom and Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kesavan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kesavan is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Kesha' meaning hair and 'Van' meaning protector. The name is derived from Lord Shiva who is known as Keshav or Keshanatha, the protector of hair and the one who has the power to control all the senses. Therefore, Kesavan is a name that represents wisdom, power and loyalty.
